successCriteria.description: The `LeaveRequest` interface is defined in `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` with all 17 canonical fields: `id`, `employeeId`, `leavePolicyId`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `reason`, `status` (typed as `LeaveRequestStatus`), `approvedBy`, `approvedAt`, `rejectedBy`, `rejectedAt`, `rejectionReason`, `cancelledBy`, `cancelledAt`, `cancellationReason`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`.
`CreateLeaveRequestDto` is defined in `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` with required fields `employeeId`, `leavePolicyId`, `startDate`, `endDate` and optional `reason`.

`UpdateLeaveRequestDto` is defined in `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` as a `Partial`-like shape covering status-relevant fields (`status`, `approvedBy`, `approvedAt`, `rejectedBy`, `rejectedAt`, `rejectionReason`, `cancelledBy`, `cancelledAt`, `cancellationReason`, `reason`).
`LeaveRequestQueryParams` is defined in `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` with optional filter fields: `status` (`LeaveRequestStatus`), `employeeId`, `startDate`, `endDate`.

`ILeaveRequestRepository` is defined in `src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts` with all 8 methods: `findById`, `findByEmployee`, `findByStatus`, `findByDateRange`, `query`, `create`, `update`, `delete` — each with the correct signature matching PLAN.md.

`ILeaveService` is defined in `src/modules/leave/leave.service.interface.ts` with all 8 methods: `create`, `submit`, `approve`, `reject`, `cancel`, `getById`, `getByEmployee`, `query` — each with the correct signature matching PLAN.md.
`LeaveRequest` imports `LeaveRequestStatus` from `src/shared/types/index.ts` (Phase 1 dependency) — no local redefinition of the enum.

constraints: All three files (`leave.model.ts`, `leave.repository.ts`, `leave.service.interface.ts`) must compile under strict TypeScript (`no implicit any`, `strict null checks`) with zero errors.
No runtime logic, no implementations, no database calls, no HTTP handlers — this phase produces only type definitions and interface contracts.
No `any` types — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`).
The `LeaveRequest` interface must use `LeaveRequestStatus` enum (imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts`) for the `status` field — not a string literal union.
outOfScope: `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts` — service implementation with cross-module wiring (employee, policy, balance, audit) belongs to sibling sub-phase "Phase 6b: Leave module — service, routes & barrel export".
`src/modules/leave/leave.routes.ts` — Fastify route definitions belong to sibling sub-phase "Phase 6b: Leave module — service, routes & barrel export".
`src/modules/leave/index.ts` — barrel export belongs to sibling sub-phase "Phase 6b: Leave module — service, routes & barrel export".

entityInvariants.invariant: The `status` field must be typed as `LeaveRequestStatus` (the shared enum), not as a plain string. The lifecycle states are DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED | REJECTED; cancellable from DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or APPROVED into CANCELLED.

Actor timestamp fields (`approvedBy`/`approvedAt`, `rejectedBy`/`rejectedAt`, `cancelledBy`/`cancelledAt`) are paired: when one member of a pair is non-null, the other must also be non-null. The interface shape enforces this through the type system by keeping both as `string | null` / `Date | null` — the implementation (Phase 6b) must enforce the pairing at runtime.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at repository layer — auth is enforced at the service/route layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns the created `LeaveRequest` with server-generated `id`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. Must accept `Omit<LeaveRequest, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>`.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must have `manager` or `hr_admin` role (enforced at route layer, not in this interface).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must reject if current status is not SUBMITTED (409 conflict). Must accept `approverId: string` and return the updated `LeaveRequest`.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must have `manager` or `hr_admin` role (enforced at route layer).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must reject if current status is not SUBMITTED (409 conflict). Must accept `rejectorId: string` and `reason: string` and return the updated `LeaveRequest`.
